I systematically checked every concrete claim (numbers, statistics, locations, study results, mechanisms) against the source findings, and verified each citation key attributes to the correct paper:

- **Overview**: framing/summary groupings; bundled citations all belong to their respective thematic sets.
- **Macropores/biopores**: Shipitalo2004 (106 burrows m⁻², 6–1043/358/1080 mL min⁻¹), Stamm2002, Zehe2001 (~50 burrows to 90 cm, isoproturon precondition) — all supported.
- **Visualisation**: Nielsen2015 (4/7 vs 1/6 SEM, 5/13 dye), Petersen2012 (0.38–0.93 kPa, 1-m band, non-random) — supported.
- **Active macroporosity**: Villholth1998 (0.17%/0.5%, factors 20/400), Frey2011 (MAF 0.0036–0.0087, r=0.79/≥0.83, fractures 15/2/7%) — supported.
- **Spatial**: Alakukku2010 (44%, 89 m⁻², P=0.04, 31% lower Kfsat), Frey2011, Montagne2009 (34–55% runoff) — supported.
- **Static structure**: HUNDAL1976, Nakajima2014, GROFFMAN1984, Caron2025 (>93%, Ds/Do 0.16/0.0001), LAL1993 (1.44 vs 1.43), Baker2004 (~11%), FAUSEY1992, Kumar2014 (18–27%), SMEDEMA1993 — supported.
- **Hydraulic evolution**: JHA1995 (3.9→10.5 mm h⁻¹), Frankl2023 (7.58 cm h⁻¹), JafariTalukolaee2016/Talukolaee2018, Moroizumi2004 (11 h, 55.2 vs 38.8 mm), MANSELL1980, Saulys2006 (3.2/2.2/0.83 m d⁻¹) — supported.
- **Mole/subsoiling**: HARRIS1993 (90%, 216 mm, 16%, 25%), PLAMENAC1988 (20%, 50 cm/3 d, 2 d), MULLER1988 (0.55 m, 3–7 yr, 54 mo, 20 yr), Castanheira2010 (1333/1029, 22%, 0.1 m), Muirhead1996, Greenwood2006, Jung2024 — supported.
- **Strength/crusting**: HUNDAL1976/FAUSEY1969, STEINHARDT1974 (−3 to −20 cm, 670 kg, 50–60 cm), Wamono2016/b, Baker2004, Kumar2014, Shabanpour2022, Kaur2023 (1292/1197/1084 kPa), Jin2008, PLAMENAC1988 (2–3°C, 10 d) — supported.
- **Pedogenesis**: Montagne2010/2008/2013 (>1/3 Fe, 16 yr, 18–>50% lutum, deterministic chaos), Mercier2000 (>80%, 60%<200 nm, 2:1 phyllosilicates), YliHalla2009 (~70 yr, Cryaqualf) — supported.
- **Transport/models**: Villholth1998, Frey2012 (1 h, 2 mm h⁻¹, 8/27/95%), Kladivko2023 (10/50/90%), Stamm2002/Geohring2001 (5 min), Akay2007/2008 (fivefold, 20–25 cm), Köhne2006 (>60%), Villholth1998b (10 vs 21%), Fox2004/Fox2007b (2% EF), Li2023d, Ford2017 (48%/43%), Poon2021, Holbak2021, AURA1995/Bechtold2007 — all supported and correctly attributed.

All concrete claims are faithful to the findings, and every citation key matches the paper the claim derives from.
